0fff1834-c23b-448b-8595-92fa143456e7.source: Bloody Mannequin Orchestra were an influential early 1980s punk band from Bethesda, Maryland.
0fff1834-c23b-448b-8595-92fa143456e7.text: Bloody Mannequin Orchestra 是来自马里兰州贝塞斯达的一支颇具影响力的1980年代早期朋克乐队。

8dd30e73-c5e9-43bf-bcce-8fc44d54a84d.source: Record Club was a musical project initiated by Beck in June 2009.
8dd30e73-c5e9-43bf-bcce-8fc44d54a84d.text: Record Club 是贝克（Beck）于2009年6月发起的音乐项目。

55c24ef0-82ad-4bd4-8b97-739690d43612.source: Rodney & the Tube Tops was an American alternative rock supergroup from Seattle, Washington.
55c24ef0-82ad-4bd4-8b97-739690d43612.text: Rodney & the Tube Tops 是一支来自华盛顿州西雅图的美国另类摇滚超级乐队。

e8b2f9f2-f5fd-4a24-aaa4-d9bebf8675e7.source: Chelsea Light Moving was an American alternative rock band formed in 2012 in New York City.
e8b2f9f2-f5fd-4a24-aaa4-d9bebf8675e7.text: Chelsea Light Moving 是一支美国另类摇滚乐队，于 2012 年在纽约市成立。

bb0df069-702b-4518-b17e-0bd64045b1be.source: Action Swingers was an American indie rock/garage punk band formed in the late 1980s in New York City, fronted by singer/guitarist Ned Hayden, who was the only constant member.
bb0df069-702b-4518-b17e-0bd64045b1be.text: Action Swingers 是一支美国独立摇滚/车库朋克乐队，成立于 20 世纪 80 年代末的纽约市，由主唱兼吉他手内德·海登（Ned Hayden）领军，他是乐队中唯一一位始终在队的成员。

ad1358df-3f53-4683-b671-49c1e39b78a7.source: Body/Head are an American experimental electric guitar duo composed of Kim Gordon and Bill Nace.
ad1358df-3f53-4683-b671-49c1e39b78a7.text: Body/Head 是一支由金·戈登（Kim Gordon）和比尔·奈斯（Bill Nace）组成的美国实验性电吉他二人组。

4a9d8c32-a22c-4712-8fa2-286d78f9458f.source: The Dustdevils (sometimes styled as DustDevils, Dust Devils, or DUSTdevils) were a noise rock band based out of New York City for most of its existence.
4a9d8c32-a22c-4712-8fa2-286d78f9458f.text: The Dustdevils（有时也写作 DustDevils、Dust Devils 或 DUSTdevils）是一支噪音摇滚乐队，在其大部分活动期间都以纽约市为据点。

ba6bba0c-c9c8-47e9-ac09-f58c03fc56ff.source: Glitterbust are an American experimental electric guitar duo composed of Kim Gordon and Alex Knost.
ba6bba0c-c9c8-47e9-ac09-f58c03fc56ff.text: Glitterbust 是一支由金·戈登（Kim Gordon）和亚历克斯·诺斯特（Alex Knost）组成的美国实验性电吉他二人组。

3b70e3f4-72ec-43bd-852e-e67240d43b08.source: Eyes Adrift (known in Australia as Bud, Curt & Krist) was a three-piece rock supergroup consisting of Krist Novoselic (bass guitar, formerly of Nirvana), Curt Kirkwood (guitar and lead vocals, of Meat Puppets), and Bud Gaugh (drums, formerly of Sublime and Long Beach Dub Allstars).
3b70e3f4-72ec-43bd-852e-e67240d43b08.text: Eyes Adrift（在澳大利亚被称为Bud, Curt & Krist）是一支三人摇滚超级乐队，由克里斯特·诺沃塞利奇（贝斯手，前涅槃乐队成员）、 Curt Kirkwood（吉他兼主唱，来自Meat Puppets乐队）以及Bud Gaugh（鼓手，曾效力于Sublime和Long Beach Dub Allstars乐队）。

4e99b3a5-654b-43ee-a9bf-c55c155c0495.source: Flipper is an American punk rock band formed in San Francisco, California in 1979, continuing in often erratic fashion until the mid-1990s, then reuniting in 2005.
4e99b3a5-654b-43ee-a9bf-c55c155c0495.text: Flipper 是一支美国朋克摇滚乐队，于 1979 年在加利福尼亚州旧金山成立，此后活动时断时续，一直持续到 1990 年代中期，随后于 2005 年重组。

b9f52132-28af-4cea-9558-165cd125f9b7.source: Scream is an American hardcore punk band from Washington, D.C.
b9f52132-28af-4cea-9558-165cd125f9b7.text: Scream 是一支来自华盛顿特区的美国硬核朋克乐队。

a9208290-48fe-49fb-876c-6b8a18654bc7.source: The No WTO Combo was a one-shot punk rock band started by Krist Novoselic (former Nirvana bassist).
a9208290-48fe-49fb-876c-6b8a18654bc7.text: The No WTO Combo 是一支由克里斯·诺沃塞利克（前涅槃乐队贝斯手）组建的单场演出朋克摇滚乐队。

653f2e2e-ed6b-4844-9d27-2009559d9822.source: Mind Funk (spelled Mindfunk on later releases) was an American rock band, containing members of Chemical Waste and several other bands.
653f2e2e-ed6b-4844-9d27-2009559d9822.text: Mind Funk（后期发行作品中拼写为Mindfunk）是一支美国摇滚乐队，成员包括来自Chemical Waste以及其他几支乐队的乐手。

210c57b3-91dc-48db-9487-97f30719ea81.source: BulletBoys is an American hard rock/glam metal band formed in Los Angeles in 1987.
210c57b3-91dc-48db-9487-97f30719ea81.text: BulletBoys 是一支成立于 1987 年洛杉矶的美国硬摇滚/华丽金属乐队。

387ae7c0-187a-45b8-9eca-72c389f003e4.source: Brides of Destruction was an American hard rock supergroup from Los Angeles, California, formed in 2002.
387ae7c0-187a-45b8-9eca-72c389f003e4.text: Brides of Destruction 是一支来自加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的美国硬摇滚超级乐队，成立于 2002 年。

388fe5dc-db1a-4ada-86f3-d3b850ae3535.source: Adler's Appetite was an American rock band from Los Angeles, formed in 2003.
388fe5dc-db1a-4ada-86f3-d3b850ae3535.text: Adler's Appetite 是一支来自洛杉矶的美国摇滚乐队，成立于 2003 年。

aff5ddd6-f315-4187-8522-25bf11a0f91e.source: Ima Robot is an American band based in Los Angeles, California, that formed in the late 1990s.
aff5ddd6-f315-4187-8522-25bf11a0f91e.text: Ima Robot 是一支来自美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的乐队，成立于 20 世纪 90 年代末。

20fa3e73-7ac4-4550-b9f5-6ac8c523bda5.source: Love Battery is an American rock band from Seattle, Washington.
20fa3e73-7ac4-4550-b9f5-6ac8c523bda5.text: Love Battery 是一支来自华盛顿州西雅图的美国摇滚乐队。

b7e61a98-84d5-4efc-866c-7166e3daa523.source: Contraband was a short-lived supergroup/side project that included members of several famous rock bands from the 1980s, such as Shark Island, McAuley Schenker Group, Ratt, L.
b7e61a98-84d5-4efc-866c-7166e3daa523.text: Contraband 是一支短暂存在的超级乐队/副业项目，成员来自 1980 年代的几支著名摇滚乐队，例如 Shark Island、McAuley Schenker Group、Ratt、L.

4caec583-cdcb-437c-af84-8797b11b6807.source: Peeping Tom were an American rock project led by Mike Patton, active between 2000 and 2007.
4caec583-cdcb-437c-af84-8797b11b6807.text: Peeping Tom 是由迈克·帕顿（Mike Patton）领军的美国摇滚乐队，活跃于2000年至2007年。

2df26979-0928-49fc-98e8-063d42bfbba1.source: London is an American glam metal band formed in Hollywood, California in 1978.
2df26979-0928-49fc-98e8-063d42bfbba1.text: London是一支美国华丽金属乐队，于1978年在加利福尼亚州好莱坞成立。

85382364-e2bc-4803-90b4-29bb3da200ce.source: Loaded (also known as Duff McKagan's Loaded) was an American rock band from Seattle, Washington, formed in 1999.
85382364-e2bc-4803-90b4-29bb3da200ce.text: Loaded（又名Duff McKagan's Loaded）是一支来自华盛顿州西雅图的美国摇滚乐队，成立于1999年。

2a7e17f0-dc67-4902-ad4b-20bd986e847b.source: OLD (originally an acronym for Old Lady Drivers) was an American heavy metal band from Bergenfield, New Jersey, formed in 1986 and signed to Earache Records.
2a7e17f0-dc67-4902-ad4b-20bd986e847b.text: OLD（最初是“Old Lady Drivers”的首字母缩写）是一支来自新泽西州伯根菲尔德的美国重金属乐队，成立于1986年，并与Earache Records签约。

2cffac8e-9bb3-47f2-b59e-0781398b0c7e.source: Shrinebuilder was an American stoner/doom metal supergroup consisting of various established musicians, particularly of the doom metal subgenre.
2cffac8e-9bb3-47f2-b59e-0781398b0c7e.text: Shrinebuilder 是一支由多位知名音乐人组成的美国迷幻/厄运金属超级乐队，其成员主要来自厄运金属子流派。

74e940a6-b64a-4e75-891a-3d976d533208.source: The Gunga Din was an American rock band formed in 1998 in New York City.
74e940a6-b64a-4e75-891a-3d976d533208.text: The Gunga Din 是一支于 1998 年在纽约市成立的美国摇滚乐队。

62788614-b33c-42c9-9b6e-c9375362b57e.source: The Messthetics is an American musical group founded by bassist Joe Lally and drummer Brendan Canty of Fugazi, along with guitarist Anthony Pirog.
62788614-b33c-42c9-9b6e-c9375362b57e.text: The Messthetics 是一支美国乐队，由 Fugazi 乐队的贝斯手乔·拉利（Joe Lally）和鼓手布伦丹·坎蒂（Brendan Canty），以及吉他手安东尼·皮罗格（Anthony Pirog）共同创立。

d471b090-3866-4cf3-b8a0-476e11f30a58.source: Coriky is an American alternative rock band from Washington D.C., formed in 2015.
d471b090-3866-4cf3-b8a0-476e11f30a58.text: Coriky是一支来自华盛顿特区的美国另类摇滚乐队，成立于2015年。

e6d8c1dd-e7bc-4e44-87ad-66aa2d3e6580.source: Wylde Ratttz were an American punk rock supergroup.
e6d8c1dd-e7bc-4e44-87ad-66aa2d3e6580.text: Wylde Ratttz 是一支美国朋克摇滚超级乐队。

3fe64039-d8e0-4ac2-838f-9a3bf97c4931.source: Fastbacks are a Seattle, Washington, punk rock band.
3fe64039-d8e0-4ac2-838f-9a3bf97c4931.text: Fastbacks 是一支来自华盛顿州西雅图的朋克摇滚乐队。

4488bb49-dc2a-4297-b486-e3405a010bd5.source: Fat Les were a British band consisting of Blur bassist Alex James, actor Keith Allen, and artist Damien Hirst.
4488bb49-dc2a-4297-b486-e3405a010bd5.text: Fat Les 是一支英国乐队，成员包括 Blur 乐队的贝斯手亚历克斯·詹姆斯、演员基思·艾伦以及艺术家达米恩·赫斯特。

2e95c700-0e9c-4fc9-9828-ddaebba37632.source: The Fartz were a hardcore punk band that was founded in 1981 and were one of the first well-known bands in their genre from Seattle, Washington.
2e95c700-0e9c-4fc9-9828-ddaebba37632.text: The Fartz 是一支成立于 1981 年的硬核朋克乐队，也是华盛顿州西雅图地区该流派中最早崭露头角的知名乐队之一。

78e497ff-b3d2-45e6-a179-f39253df4ea4.source: Men of Porn, sometimes typeset as Porn (The Men Of) and now simply known as Porn, is an American, San Francisco-based stoner rock band.
78e497ff-b3d2-45e6-a179-f39253df4ea4.text: Men of Porn（有时也写作 Porn (The Men Of)，现简称为 Porn）是一支来自美国旧金山的斯通纳摇滚乐队。

5656fd4b-d35d-4741-966b-32dee833c0a5.source: Me Me Me were a one-off English Britpop supergroup formed in 1996, consisting of Alex James of Blur (vocals, bass), Stephen Duffy (vocals, guitar) previously of Duran Duran/The Lilac Time, Justin Welch of Elastica (drums), and James' friend Charlie Bloor (credited as "musician").
5656fd4b-d35d-4741-966b-32dee833c0a5.text: Me Me Me 是一支于 1996 年组建的英国布里特波普（Britpop）超级乐队，仅此一次，成员包括来自 Blur 乐队的 Alex James（主唱、贝斯）、 曾效力于Duran Duran和The Lilac Time乐队的斯蒂芬·达菲（主唱、吉他）、Elastica乐队的贾斯汀·韦尔奇（鼓手），以及詹姆斯的朋友查理·布卢尔（在专辑中被列为“乐手”）。

76d721ac-3eff-4b6d-8a2e-f2dacd2209a3.source: Walt Mink were an American alternative rock power trio from St. Paul, Minnesota.
76d721ac-3eff-4b6d-8a2e-f2dacd2209a3.text: Walt Mink 是一支来自明尼苏达州圣保罗市的美国另类摇滚三人组合。

5ba39b83-d12d-4b31-b449-992300a73df8.source: Peter Kember (born 19 November 1965), also known by his stage name Sonic Boom, is an English singer-songwriter, composer and record producer.
5ba39b83-d12d-4b31-b449-992300a73df8.text: 彼得·肯伯（Peter Kember，1965年11月19日出生），艺名“Sonic Boom”，是一位英国唱作人、作曲家和唱片制作人。

23f527e1-74ae-4f7c-94f3-4a5d5f379c51.source: Hope Sandoval & The Warm Inventions are an American-Irish dream pop band comprising Hope Sandoval of Mazzy Star and Colm Ó Cíosóig of My Bloody Valentine.
23f527e1-74ae-4f7c-94f3-4a5d5f379c51.text: Hope Sandoval & The Warm Inventions 是一支美爱混血梦幻流行乐队，由 Mazzy Star 乐队的 Hope Sandoval 和 My Bloody Valentine 乐队的 Colm Ó Cíosóig 组成。

a47f322c-dde7-4ece-b6f2-b0468aff8861.source: WigWam were an English pop duo, comprising Alex James, the bassist from Blur, and vocalist Betty Boo (Alison Clarkson).
a47f322c-dde7-4ece-b6f2-b0468aff8861.text: WigWam是一支英国流行乐二人组，由Blur乐队的贝斯手亚历克斯·詹姆斯（Alex James）和主唱贝蒂·布（Betty Boo，本名艾莉森·克拉克森，Alison Clarkson）组成。

33ee7545-047b-4694-a5be-741ea50b8b73.source: Starclub was an early 1990s rock band from England, consisting of Owen Vyse (lead vocals, guitar, Hammond organ, keyboards), Steve French (guitar, backing vocals), Julian Taylor (bass, backing vocals) and Alan White (drums, percussion).
33ee7545-047b-4694-a5be-741ea50b8b73.text: Starclub 是 20 世纪 90 年代初来自英格兰的一支摇滚乐队，成员包括欧文·维斯（主唱、吉他、哈蒙德风琴、键盘）、史蒂夫·弗伦奇（吉他、和声）、朱利安·泰勒（贝斯、和声）和艾伦·怀特（鼓、打击乐）。

9f1d095a-0114-411c-8a66-dd3995e571a9.source: The Ailerons were an English indie rock band featuring Charity Hair, Daniel Beattie, Dave Rowntree, Grog Prebble and Mike Smith.
9f1d095a-0114-411c-8a66-dd3995e571a9.text: The Ailerons 是一支来自英国的独立摇滚乐队，成员包括 Charity Hair、Daniel Beattie、Dave Rowntree、Grog Prebble 和 Mike Smith。

aaa673a8-af81-4140-8cb8-800406c1eace.source: Bundle of Hiss was an American grunge band formed in 1980 in Stanwood, Washington by future Tad member Kurt Danielson, guitarist Jeff Hopper, vocalist Kurt Schonberg and drummer Russ Bartlett.
aaa673a8-af81-4140-8cb8-800406c1eace.text: Bundle of Hiss 是一支美国垃圾摇滚乐队，于 1980 年在华盛顿州的斯坦伍德由后来加入 Tad 乐队的库尔特·丹尼尔森、吉他手杰夫·霍珀、主唱库尔特·肖恩伯格和鼓手拉斯·巴特利特共同组建。

edb1beeb-f780-4e56-bc82-8499ca7e3e3e.source: Mico de Noche is an American stoner sludge metal band from Seattle, Washington.
edb1beeb-f780-4e56-bc82-8499ca7e3e3e.text: Mico de Noche 是一支来自华盛顿州西雅图的美国迷幻泥浆金属乐队。

946202eb-2207-4d63-9ef3-69bb1ea4a199.source: The Gentlemen was an American rock band from Seattle, Washington, formed in 1998.
946202eb-2207-4d63-9ef3-69bb1ea4a199.text: The Gentlemen 是一支来自华盛顿州西雅图的美国摇滚乐队，成立于1998年。

54bfa733-5012-4aae-b24f-fc9e36cf4ddf.source: Anywhere is a psychedelic rock/folk music project from Los Angeles, California, founded by Christian Eric Beaulieu (formerly of Triclops!
54bfa733-5012-4aae-b24f-fc9e36cf4ddf.text: Anywhere 是一个来自加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的迷幻摇滚/民谣音乐项目，由克里斯蒂安·埃里克·博利厄（曾任 Triclops! 乐队成员）创立。

cf7e57f4-d310-4a00-8bbb-6c30e2046ae8.source: Walking Papers is an American rock band from Seattle, Washington, formed in 2012.
cf7e57f4-d310-4a00-8bbb-6c30e2046ae8.text: Walking Papers 是一支来自华盛顿州西雅图的美国摇滚乐队，成立于 2012 年。

b9a9487b-abf6-4a95-a8fd-238cc093e99b.source: The Sound City Players were a supergroup formed by ex-Nirvana drummer and Foo Fighters guitarist and lead-singer Dave Grohl.
b9a9487b-abf6-4a95-a8fd-238cc093e99b.text: The Sound City Players 是一支由前涅槃乐队（Nirvana）鼓手、Foo Fighters 乐队吉他手兼主唱戴夫·格罗尔（Dave Grohl）组建的超级乐队。

56396fbe-e455-4526-a5e4-2a8f9b01c435.source: Kings of Chaos is a hard rock supergroup with international membership featuring a core lineup of drummer Matt Sorum, bassist Duff McKagan, and guitarist Gilby Clarke (all then formerly of Guns N' Roses), as well as revolving appearances from members of Def Leppard, Deep Purple, Aerosmith and more.
56396fbe-e455-4526-a5e4-2a8f9b01c435.text: Kings of Chaos 是一支由国际乐手组成的硬摇滚超级乐队，核心阵容包括鼓手马特·索鲁姆（Matt Sorum）、贝斯手达夫·麦卡根（Duff McKagan）和吉他手吉尔比·克拉克（Gilby Clarke）（三人当时均曾是枪与玫瑰乐队成员），此外还有来自 Def Leppard、Deep Purple、Aerosmith 等乐队的成员不定期参与演出。

d2b89c0c-89fa-42a1-b36b-59c99653fefd.source: Adler was an American hard rock supergroup from Los Angeles, California, formed in 2012 by former Guns N' Roses drummer Steven Adler.
d2b89c0c-89fa-42a1-b36b-59c99653fefd.text: Adler是一支来自加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的美国硬摇滚超级乐队，由前“枪与玫瑰”乐队鼓手史蒂文·阿德勒于2012年组建。

f319b299-2d27-4b47-af56-a5747d7ac0f3.source: Filthy Friends is an alt-rock supergroup based in Portland, Oregon.
f319b299-2d27-4b47-af56-a5747d7ac0f3.text: Filthy Friends 是一支来自俄勒冈州波特兰市的另类摇滚超级乐队。

a92a55c3-5780-40ad-89c2-e62e58b2bc32.source: Praxis is an experimental rock project, led by producer/bassist Bill Laswell and featuring guitarist Buckethead and drummer Brain in nearly every incarnation of the band.
a92a55c3-5780-40ad-89c2-e62e58b2bc32.text: Praxis 是一个实验摇滚项目，由制作人兼贝斯手比尔·拉斯韦尔（Bill Laswell）领衔，吉他手巴克特海德（Buckethead）和鼓手布莱恩（Brain）几乎参与了该乐队的所有阵容。

7a2e6b55-f149-4e74-be6a-30a1b1a387bb.source: The Desert Sessions are a musical collective series, founded by Josh Homme in 1997.
7a2e6b55-f149-4e74-be6a-30a1b1a387bb.text: “沙漠音乐会”（The Desert Sessions）是一系列音乐合作项目，由乔什·霍姆（Josh Homme）于1997年创立。

4297d19f-4483-494c-a993-0e29a5afac33.source: Colonel Claypool's Bucket of Bernie Brains (C2B3) was an experimental rock supergroup featuring bassist Les Claypool, guitarist Buckethead, keyboardist Bernie Worrell and drummer Brain.
4297d19f-4483-494c-a993-0e29a5afac33.text: “克莱普尔上校的伯尼大脑桶”（Colonel Claypool's Bucket of Bernie Brains，简称 C2B3）是一支实验摇滚超级乐队，成员包括贝斯手莱斯·克莱普尔（Les Claypool）、吉他手巴克特海德（Buckethead）、键盘手伯尼·沃雷尔（Bernie Worrell）和鼓手布莱恩（Brain）。

0cb4663d-70a1-4fcd-96ff-8674cb51b7d3.source: Tapeworm was an American side project of Nine Inch Nails which existed in various forms from 1995 to roughly 2004.
0cb4663d-70a1-4fcd-96ff-8674cb51b7d3.text: Tapeworm 是九寸钉（Nine Inch Nails）的一个美国分支项目，从1995年到大约2004年期间以多种形式存在。

c0eee88b-47f2-4cd2-ac48-a045e902a432.source: Ween is an American rock band from New Hope, Pennsylvania, formed in 1984 by Aaron Freeman and Mickey Melchiondo, better known by their respective stage names, Gene Ween and Dean Ween.
c0eee88b-47f2-4cd2-ac48-a045e902a432.text: Ween是一支来自宾夕法尼亚州新希望镇的美国摇滚乐队，由亚伦·弗里曼（Aaron Freeman）和米基·梅尔基翁多（Mickey Melchiondo）于1984年组建，两人更广为人知的艺名分别是吉恩·威恩（Gene Ween）和迪恩·威恩（Dean Ween）。

a33ecf1b-a4ed-43e4-b6ab-26623b40cfad.source: Black Light Burns was an American industrial rock band fronted by Wes Borland.
a33ecf1b-a4ed-43e4-b6ab-26623b40cfad.text: Black Light Burns 是一支由韦斯·博兰德（Wes Borland）担任主唱的美国工业摇滚乐队。

9ee41ce7-b865-46f1-8f02-895c950b0a8a.source: The Deli Creeps were an avant-garde metal band consisting of singer Maximum Bob, guitarist Buckethead, drummer Pinchface and various bass players, most recently Daniel Monti.
9ee41ce7-b865-46f1-8f02-895c950b0a8a.text: The Deli Creeps 是一支前卫金属乐队，由主唱 Maximum Bob、吉他手 Buckethead、鼓手 Pinchface 以及多位贝斯手组成，最近的贝斯手是 Daniel Monti。

260b0a6c-b464-4acd-bbd1-9dbb00703207.source: Beautiful Creatures (sometimes abbreviated as BC) is an American hard rock band formed in 1999 by guitarist DJ Ashba and singer Joe Lesté of Bang Tango.
260b0a6c-b464-4acd-bbd1-9dbb00703207.text: Beautiful Creatures（有时简称为BC）是一支美国硬摇滚乐队，由吉他手DJ Ashba和Bang Tango乐队的主唱Joe Lesté于1999年组建。

d703af9a-d993-4f00-92aa-14ea284e39bd.source: Love Spit Love was an English–American alternative rock band founded in 1992 by the English singer Richard Butler during the 1990s hiatus of the Psychedelic Furs.
d703af9a-d993-4f00-92aa-14ea284e39bd.text: Love Spit Love 是一支英美混血另类摇滚乐队，由英国歌手理查德·巴特勒（Richard Butler）于 1992 年在 Psychedelic Furs 乐队 1990 年代暂停活动期间创立。

c5902edd-de59-43cc-a93f-07ada835fe86.source: Slash's Blues Ball was an American blues rock band that formed in Los Angeles, California in 1996.
c5902edd-de59-43cc-a93f-07ada835fe86.text: Slash's Blues Ball 是一支美国蓝调摇滚乐队，于 1996 年在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶成立。

6e926752-885a-4239-87fc-62ae76f47d98.source: Cornbugs was an American avant-garde metal band formed in 1995.
6e926752-885a-4239-87fc-62ae76f47d98.text: Cornbugs 是一支成立于 1995 年的美国前卫金属乐队。

03214f15-3323-4964-8b9e-1d71496fa524.source: Medication was an American rock band that included Logan Mader, Whitfield Crane, B.
03214f15-3323-4964-8b9e-1d71496fa524.text: Medication是一支美国摇滚乐队，成员包括洛根·马德（Logan Mader）、惠特菲尔德·克雷恩（Whitfield Crane）和B.

e935d070-004d-405a-8b9d-1d9e51590b55.source: The Dead Daisies are an Australian-American hard rock band formed in Sydney in 2012.
e935d070-004d-405a-8b9d-1d9e51590b55.text: The Dead Daisies 是一支澳美硬摇滚乐队，于 2012 年在悉尼成立。

7294f7d2-743d-483c-84fd-d0c0ffd9a234.source: Art of Anarchy is an American rock supergroup formed in 2011, which currently consists of brothers Jon and Vince Votta on guitar and drums, Tony Dickinson on bass, Ron "Bumblefoot" Thal (ex-Guns N' Roses, ex-Asia, Sons of Apollo) on guitar and production, and Jeff Scott Soto (Sons of Apollo, ex-Talisman, ex-Journey) on lead vocals.
7294f7d2-743d-483c-84fd-d0c0ffd9a234.text: Art of Anarchy 是一支成立于 2011 年的美国摇滚超级乐队，目前由担任吉他手和鼓手的乔恩·沃塔（Jon Votta）与文斯·沃塔（Vince Votta）兄弟、贝斯手托尼·迪金森（Tony Dickinson）、负责吉他演奏和制作的罗恩·“邦布尔福特” Thal（前“枪与玫瑰”乐队成员、前“亚洲”乐队成员、“阿波罗之子”乐队成员）担任吉他手兼制作人，以及杰夫·斯科特·索托（“阿波罗之子”乐队成员、前“塔利斯曼”乐队成员、前“旅程”乐队成员）担任主唱。

0efa265c-e11a-4a37-a0de-5b40417587de.source: The I Don't Cares are a musical collaboration between Paul Westerberg and Juliana Hatfield that released their debut album Wild Stab in January 2016.
0efa265c-e11a-4a37-a0de-5b40417587de.text: The I Don't Cares 是保罗·韦斯特伯格（Paul Westerberg）与朱莉安娜·哈特菲尔德（Juliana Hatfield）合作组建的乐队，于2016年1月发行了首张专辑《Wild Stab》。

16e4f976-dda8-4468-bbbe-a3a52d779cb5.source: The Jaded Hearts Club is a rock supergroup and covers band consisting of Miles Kane (of the Rascals and Last Shadow Puppets), Nic Cester (of Jet), Matt Bellamy (of Muse), Jamie Davis (of former member Graham Coxon's former label Transcopic) and Sean Payne (of the Zutons).
16e4f976-dda8-4468-bbbe-a3a52d779cb5.text: The Jaded Hearts Club 是一支摇滚超级乐队兼翻唱乐队，成员包括迈尔斯·凯恩（曾效力于 The Rascals 和 The Last Shadow Puppets）、 尼克·塞斯特（Nic Cester，来自乐队 Jet）、马特·贝拉米（Matt Bellamy，来自乐队 Muse）、杰米·戴维斯（Jamie Davis，曾隶属于前成员格雷厄姆·考克森（Graham Coxon）的旧厂牌 Transcopic）以及肖恩·佩恩（Sean Payne，来自乐队 The Zutons）。

8da60c20-2608-4113-921d-72ffd22ef953.source: Deadland Ritual was a British–American hard rock supergroup band originally formed in Los Angeles in 2018, the band is a supergroup composed of vocalist Franky Perez (Apocalyptica), guitarist Steve Stevens (Billy Idol, Michael Jackson), bassist Geezer Butler (Black Sabbath, Heaven and Hell) and drummer Matt Sorum (the Cult, Guns N' Roses, Velvet Revolver and many others).
8da60c20-2608-4113-921d-72ffd22ef953.text: Deadland Ritual是一支英美硬摇滚超级乐队，最初于2018年在洛杉矶成立，该乐队由主唱弗兰基·佩雷斯（Franky Perez，曾效力于Apocalyptica）、吉他手史蒂夫·史蒂文斯 （曾效力于比利·艾多尔、迈克尔·杰克逊乐队）、贝斯手吉泽·巴特勒（曾效力于黑色安息日、天堂与地狱）以及鼓手马特·索鲁姆（曾效力于邪教乐队、枪与玫瑰、天鹅绒革命等众多乐队）组成的超级乐队。

3b9d785f-8188-4397-9f7b-5ed3828cb32e.source: Giants in the Trees was an American rock band formed in Wahkiakum County, Washington, in 2017.
3b9d785f-8188-4397-9f7b-5ed3828cb32e.text: Giants in the Trees 是一支美国摇滚乐队，于 2017 年在华盛顿州的瓦基阿库姆县成立。

bd39dbc4-8260-474e-830f-787dad44066c.source: Kidbug is an international supergroup composed of musicians signed to Joyful Noise Recordings.
bd39dbc4-8260-474e-830f-787dad44066c.text: Kidbug 是一支由签约 Joyful Noise Recordings 的音乐人组成的国际超级乐队。

257f77a9-d394-48c3-ba87-05bce2d60199.source: 3rd Secret is an American alternative rock supergroup formed in late 2021.
257f77a9-d394-48c3-ba87-05bce2d60199.text: 3rd Secret 是一支成立于 2021 年末的美国另类摇滚超级乐队。

ee361394-914f-4074-891a-3b17b0f89a37.source: Y Kant Tori Read was an American synth-pop band fronted by singer-songwriter Tori Amos and active between 1984 and 1989.
ee361394-914f-4074-891a-3b17b0f89a37.text: Y Kant Tori Read 是一支由唱作人托莉·阿莫斯（Tori Amos）领衔的美国合成器流行乐队，活跃于1984年至1989年。

6ffcf46f-861b-47e5-aba2-c1a930fef7ee.source: Daniel Edwin Carey (born May 10, 1961) is an American drummer who is a member of the rock band Tool.
6ffcf46f-861b-47e5-aba2-c1a930fef7ee.text: 丹尼尔·埃德温·凯里（Daniel Edwin Carey，1961年5月10日出生）是一位美国鼓手，也是摇滚乐队Tool的成员。

f80bf66a-c771-48ef-b1d3-ed76c433675a.source: Ronald David Wood (born 1 June 1947) is an English rock musician, best known as a member of the Rolling Stones since 1975, and a member of Faces and the Jeff Beck Group.
f80bf66a-c771-48ef-b1d3-ed76c433675a.text: 罗纳德·大卫·伍德（Ronald David Wood，1947年6月1日出生）是一位英国摇滚音乐人，最广为人知的是自1975年起作为滚石乐队（The Rolling Stones）成员，此外他还曾是Faces乐队和杰夫·贝克乐队（The Jeff Beck Group）的成员。

196670b6-ccbf-4a20-9d1d-a55161d1c322.source: Johnny Crash was an American hard rock band formed in 1985.
196670b6-ccbf-4a20-9d1d-a55161d1c322.text: Johnny Crash 是一支成立于 1985 年的美国硬摇滚乐队。

97e3f316-ec68-47f2-b870-bb4bd0a61f08.source: The Exies is an American rock band from Los Angeles, formed in 1997.
97e3f316-ec68-47f2-b870-bb4bd0a61f08.text: The Exies 是一支来自洛杉矶的美国摇滚乐队，成立于 1997 年。

2a3dc878-34f8-48a6-8591-caa8f7b1f70f.source: The Damning Well was a rock supergroup comprising Wes Borland of Limp Bizkit on guitar, Danny Lohner formerly of Nine Inch Nails on bass, Richard Patrick of Filter on vocals, and Josh Freese of A Perfect Circle on drums.
2a3dc878-34f8-48a6-8591-caa8f7b1f70f.text: The Damning Well 是一支摇滚超级乐队，由 Limp Bizkit 乐队的吉他手韦斯·博兰德（Wes Borland）、前 Nine Inch Nails 乐队贝斯手丹尼·洛纳（Danny Lohner）、Filter 乐队主唱理查德·帕特里克（Richard Patrick）以及 A Perfect Circle 乐队鼓手乔什·弗里斯（Josh Freese）组成。

55905821-f019-4f07-9e8b-30017dcd50c0.source: Candy was a Los Angeles-based pop rock band, featuring future Guns N' Roses guitarist Gilby Clarke and singer-songwriter Kyle Vincent.
55905821-f019-4f07-9e8b-30017dcd50c0.text: Candy是一支来自洛杉矶的流行摇滚乐队，成员包括后来加入枪与玫瑰乐队的吉他手吉尔比·克拉克（Gilby Clarke）以及唱作人凯尔·文森特（Kyle Vincent）。

64b20ec0-db9e-4a06-924e-1f5d87e26669.source: Daredevils was an American punk rock band from Los Angeles, California, that was composed of Brett Gurewitz, Gore Verbinski, Dean Opseth, and Josh Freese.
64b20ec0-db9e-4a06-924e-1f5d87e26669.text: Daredevils 是一支来自加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的美国朋克摇滚乐队，成员包括布雷特·古雷维茨（Brett Gurewitz）、戈尔·维宾斯基（Gore Verbinski）、迪恩·奥普塞斯（Dean Opseth）和乔什·弗里斯（Josh Freese）。

c44092a6-d6be-4bfa-9650-edccc69f7a2b.source: Bash & Pop are an American alternative rock band formed in 1992 by Tommy Stinson in Minneapolis, Minnesota, following the breakup of the Replacements.
c44092a6-d6be-4bfa-9650-edccc69f7a2b.text: Bash & Pop 是一支美国另类摇滚乐队，由汤米·斯廷森（Tommy Stinson）于 1992 年在明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯市组建，此前“Replacements”乐队刚刚解散。

0177a4b0-75b0-4c2a-9501-734b942cdcd4.source: Camp Freddy was an American hard rock supergroup consisting of established musicians who played rock covers at various shows around the United States from 2002 through 2014.
0177a4b0-75b0-4c2a-9501-734b942cdcd4.text: Camp Freddy 是一支美国硬摇滚超级乐队，由多位知名音乐人组成，2002年至2014年间在美国各地的演出中演奏摇滚翻唱曲目。

dda55cb5-21b1-4450-bb21-d5b0ad35b6a2.source: Rock Star Supernova was a reality television-formed supergroup consisting of drummer Tommy Lee, bassist Jason Newsted, guitarist Gilby Clarke, and singer Lukas Rossi.
dda55cb5-21b1-4450-bb21-d5b0ad35b6a2.text: Rock Star Supernova 是一支通过真人秀节目组建的超级乐队，成员包括鼓手汤米·李（Tommy Lee）、贝斯手杰森·纽斯特德（Jason Newsted）、吉他手吉尔比·克拉克（Gilby Clarke）和主唱卢卡斯·罗西（Lukas Rossi）。

0612a024-6265-4179-a1a6-12d4141aeccc.source: Jihad Jerry & the Evildoers is the solo project of American musician Gerald Casale, best known as a founding member of the new wave band Devo.
0612a024-6265-4179-a1a6-12d4141aeccc.text: Jihad Jerry & the Evildoers 是美国音乐人杰拉尔德·卡萨莱（Gerald Casale）的个人音乐项目，他最广为人知的身份是新浪潮乐队 Devo 的创始成员之一。

0cdf71c3-1265-4e48-b211-61800be4d5ab.source: Viva Death are an American rock band formed from members of the bands Face to Face, Foo Fighters and The Vandals.
0cdf71c3-1265-4e48-b211-61800be4d5ab.text: Viva Death 是一支由 Face to Face、Foo Fighters 和 The Vandals 等乐队成员组成的美国摇滚乐队。

877f5179-607d-4a27-8361-439e4e851504.source: Circus Diablo is an American rock band formed in early 2006 by Billy Morrison (vocals), Billy Duffy (lead guitar) and Ricky Warwick (rhythm guitar).
877f5179-607d-4a27-8361-439e4e851504.text: Circus Diablo 是一支美国摇滚乐队，由比利·莫里森（主唱）、比利·达菲（主音吉他）和里基·沃里克（节奏吉他）于 2006 年初组建。

7f227d98-fced-4718-9492-83b3b3225530.source: Sinawe (Korean: 시나위; RR: Sinawi) is a heavy metal/rock band from South Korea.
7f227d98-fced-4718-9492-83b3b3225530.text: Sinawe（韩语：시나위；罗马拼音：Sinawi）是一支来自韩国的重金属/摇滚乐队。

2b4f3e93-f1e9-46e8-a78a-3edb7b7fe2b1.source: Science Faxtion is an American experimental metal band that formed in California in 2007.
2b4f3e93-f1e9-46e8-a78a-3edb7b7fe2b1.text: Science Faxtion 是一支美国实验金属乐队，于 2007 年在加利福尼亚州成立。

0cddd743-57d8-42d8-bd50-881777462812.source: Brian Patrick Carroll (born May 13, 1969), known professionally as Buckethead, is an American guitarist.
0cddd743-57d8-42d8-bd50-881777462812.text: 布莱恩·帕特里克·卡罗尔（Brian Patrick Carroll，1969年5月13日出生），艺名Buckethead，是一位美国吉他手。

079f2e2b-b3f9-4574-ac5c-add977b40762.source: Sublime with Rome was a band that began as a musical collaboration between former Sublime members Eric Wilson and Bud Gaugh, and singer and guitarist Rome Ramirez.
079f2e2b-b3f9-4574-ac5c-add977b40762.text: Sublime with Rome 是一支由前 Sublime 乐队成员埃里克·威尔逊（Eric Wilson）和巴德·高（Bud Gaugh），以及主唱兼吉他手罗姆·拉米雷斯（Rome Ramirez）共同组建的乐队。

de69798a-4d18-40e5-889e-f26580a2d62a.source: Perfect was an American alternative rock group formed in 1995 by Tommy Stinson, formerly of The Replacements, in Minneapolis, Minnesota following the breakup of previous group, Bash & Pop.
de69798a-4d18-40e5-889e-f26580a2d62a.text: Perfect是一支美国另类摇滚乐队，由前The Replacements乐队成员汤米·斯廷森（Tommy Stinson）于1995年在明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯市组建，此前他所在的乐队Bash & Pop刚刚解散。

76fc9a1d-4499-4c92-91cf-85f87ee50787.source: Deep End was a short-lived supergroup founded by guitarist Pete Townshend of the Who and featuring David Gilmour of Pink Floyd.
76fc9a1d-4499-4c92-91cf-85f87ee50787.text: Deep End 是一支短命的超级乐队，由“谁人乐队”（The Who）的吉他手皮特·汤森（Pete Townshend）创立，成员中包括“平克·弗洛伊德”（Pink Floyd）的大卫·吉尔摩（David Gilmour）。

2371ce0b-7990-4b88-af6f-6a8b01ef369a.source: Thomas Edward Yorke (born 7 October 1968) is an English musician who is the singer and main songwriter of the rock band Radiohead.
2371ce0b-7990-4b88-af6f-6a8b01ef369a.text: 托马斯·爱德华·约克（Thomas Edward Yorke，1968年10月7日出生）是一位英国音乐人，也是摇滚乐队Radiohead的主唱和主要词曲作者。

5e6512dd-160b-4512-a4b4-2c30fa894a08.source: Fear, stylized as FEAR, is an American punk rock band from Los Angeles, formed in 1977.
5e6512dd-160b-4512-a4b4-2c30fa894a08.text: Fear（艺术名称为FEAR）是一支来自洛杉矶的美国朋克摇滚乐队，成立于1977年。

309879f6-77a0-4660-999c-310223a4ef97.source: What Is This (known prior to 1980 as Anthym) was an American rock band that originated in Fairfax High School in Los Angeles, California.
309879f6-77a0-4660-999c-310223a4ef97.text: What Is This（1980年之前名为Anthym）是一支美国摇滚乐队，起源于加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的费尔法克斯高中。

6b69ad23-4b6d-4d58-8818-ff00b4e1b024.source: 12 Rods (also known by the stylistic variants 12RODS and Twelve Rods) was an American indie rock band from Minneapolis, Minnesota.
6b69ad23-4b6d-4d58-8818-ff00b4e1b024.text: 12 Rods（也以12RODS和Twelve Rods等不同写法出现）是一支来自明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯的美国独立摇滚乐队。

19184fd0-fdff-4d80-aaf6-c196d7f21946.source: Fushitsusha (不失者) is a Japanese rock band specialising in experimental and psychedelic rock genres.
19184fd0-fdff-4d80-aaf6-c196d7f21946.text: Fushitsusha（不失者）是一支专注于实验摇滚和迷幻摇滚风格的日本摇滚乐队。

1ab5659c-aa39-479e-8920-92eaa98999fe.source: The Panic Channel was an American post-hardcore band formed in Los Angeles, California, United States, in 2004, following the third break-up of Jane's Addiction.
1ab5659c-aa39-479e-8920-92eaa98999fe.text: The Panic Channel 是一支美国后硬核乐队，成立于 2004 年美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶，当时正值 Jane's Addiction 第三次解散之后。

bc57af6d-769b-490e-822d-94fab4afc135.source: Hale and Pace were an English comedy double-act that performed in clubs and on radio and television in the United Kingdom in the 1980s and 1990s.
bc57af6d-769b-490e-822d-94fab4afc135.text: Hale and Pace 是一对英国喜剧搭档，于 20 世纪 80 年代和 90 年代在英国的俱乐部、广播电台和电视台进行演出。

cd1cfb42-4b49-4f86-9518-37b1dfd1a2a8.source: 7 Worlds Collide is a musical project by the New Zealand singer-songwriter Neil Finn.
cd1cfb42-4b49-4f86-9518-37b1dfd1a2a8.text: 7 Worlds Collide 是新西兰唱作人尼尔·芬恩（Neil Finn）发起的一个音乐项目。

e8bff2b6-25e0-4e58-a8bf-9c48ce993cd0.source: Kid Dakota is the musical moniker of Darren Jackson, sometimes accompanied live or in the studio by various band members.
e8bff2b6-25e0-4e58-a8bf-9c48ce993cd0.text: Kid Dakota 是达伦·杰克逊（Darren Jackson）的艺名，有时会在现场演出或录音室录制时由不同的乐队成员伴奏。

f03600eb-88b2-4cbc-858f-20535f03ca0c.source: Ringo Starr & His All-Starr Band are a live rock supergroup founded in 1989 with shifting personnel, led by former Beatles drummer and vocalist Ringo Starr.
f03600eb-88b2-4cbc-858f-20535f03ca0c.text: Ringo Starr & His All-Starr Band 是一支成立于 1989 年的现场摇滚超级乐队，成员阵容不固定，由前披头士乐队鼓手兼主唱林戈·斯塔尔领衔。

55affee6-ecb0-42b3-9f36-40b6da415871.source: Foxboro Hot Tubs is the garage rock side project of Green Day, formed in 2007.
55affee6-ecb0-42b3-9f36-40b6da415871.text: Foxboro Hot Tubs 是绿日乐队（Green Day）于2007年组建的车库摇滚副项目。

81739b1e-609d-4a63-beaa-4422ca5e278a.source: Le Knight Club was a French electronic music group formed in 1997 by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo, a member of the former French electronic duo Daft Punk, and Éric Chédeville, also known as Rico the Wizard, from Pumpking Records.
81739b1e-609d-4a63-beaa-4422ca5e278a.text: Le Knight Club 是一支法国电子乐队，由前法国电子乐二人组 Daft Punk 的成员 Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo，以及来自 Pumpking Records 且艺名为 Rico the Wizard 的 Éric Chédeville 于 1997 年共同组建。

0f4fa442-3e9c-4355-8e17-a39386a52077.source: Dead Sara is an American rock band from Los Angeles, consisting of Emily Armstrong (lead vocals, rhythm guitar), Siouxsie Medley (lead guitar, backing vocals), and Sean Friday (drums, backing vocals), best known for their single "Weatherman" from their debut album, Dead Sara (2012).
0f4fa442-3e9c-4355-8e17-a39386a52077.text: Dead Sara是一支来自洛杉矶的美国摇滚乐队，由艾米丽·阿姆斯特朗（主唱、节奏吉他）、苏西·梅德利（主吉他、和声）和肖恩·弗莱迪（鼓手、和声）组成，他们最广为人知的作品是首张专辑《Dead Sara》中的单曲《Weatherman》 （2012年）中的单曲《Weatherman》。

6084f926-d798-4468-9e2c-ba64a4b7bfbc.source: Snapline is a band based in Beijing, consisting of Li Qing on guitar and keyboards and Li Weisi on bass, who met while students at the Beijing Institute of Technology.
6084f926-d798-4468-9e2c-ba64a4b7bfbc.text: Snapline是一支驻扎在北京的乐队，由吉他手兼键盘手李青和贝斯手李伟思组成，两人是在北京理工大学求学期间相识的。

dce02d78-ec77-416a-ac25-50dfc045fc7c.source: The Justice Collective was a collective of musicians and celebrities.
dce02d78-ec77-416a-ac25-50dfc045fc7c.text: “正义联盟”（The Justice Collective）是由音乐人和名人组成的团体。

87afe5d0-f12b-4609-b0b2-ddb4ace0f908.source: Eastern Sidekick (Korean: 이스턴 사이드킥) was a South Korean indie rock band formed in 2010, but they officially debuted under Fluxus Music includes Clazziquai, Urban Zakapa in 2013.
87afe5d0-f12b-4609-b0b2-ddb4ace0f908.text: Eastern Sidekick（韩语：이스턴 사이드킥）是一支成立于2010年的韩国独立摇滚乐队，但直到2013年才在Fluxus Music旗下正式出道，该厂牌旗下还有Clazziquai和Urban Zakapa等乐队。

cba83330-32d6-4804-8058-fcf2794afb79.source: Grey Daze is an American rock band from Phoenix, Arizona formed in 1993.
cba83330-32d6-4804-8058-fcf2794afb79.text: Grey Daze 是一支来自亚利桑那州菲尼克斯的美国摇滚乐队，成立于 1993 年。

7e14cf06-532b-4789-8c03-5aa13da4f6f3.source: Infectious Grooves is an American funk metal supergroup led by vocalist Mike Muir and initially a side project from his group Suicidal Tendencies.
7e14cf06-532b-4789-8c03-5aa13da4f6f3.text: Infectious Grooves 是一支由主唱迈克·穆尔（Mike Muir）领军的美国放克金属超级乐队，最初是其所在乐队 Suicidal Tendencies 的副项目。

0f8a2f89-29c0-4085-8820-635c181a0de9.source: Axis of Justice is a non-profit organization co-founded by Serj Tankian and Tom Morello in 2002.
0f8a2f89-29c0-4085-8820-635c181a0de9.text: “正义轴心”（Axis of Justice）是一家由塞尔吉·坦基安（Serj Tankian）和汤姆·莫雷洛（Tom Morello）于2002年共同创立的非营利组织。

d9c90718-d54d-4ccf-a92e-37a5415ce299.source: The Wallflowers is an American rock solo project of American singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Jakob Dylan.
d9c90718-d54d-4ccf-a92e-37a5415ce299.text: The Wallflowers 是美国唱作人兼多乐器演奏家雅各布·迪伦（Jakob Dylan）的个人摇滚项目。

0b04d160-0def-4171-9fa0-0d9f4addc4a7.source: Thelonious Monster was an American punk rock band from Los Angeles, California, led by singer-songwriter Bob Forrest and named after jazz musician Thelonious Monk.
0b04d160-0def-4171-9fa0-0d9f4addc4a7.text: Thelonious Monster 是一支来自加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的美国朋克摇滚乐队，由唱作人鲍勃·福雷斯特（Bob Forrest）领军，其乐队名称取自爵士音乐家塞隆尼斯·蒙克（Thelonious Monk）。

700cf581-cc8c-49c1-93e3-489bf1719255.source: The Lookouts were an American punk rock band that existed from 1985 to 1990 on Iron Peak, a remote rural mountain community outside Laytonville, California.
700cf581-cc8c-49c1-93e3-489bf1719255.text: The Lookouts 是一支美国朋克摇滚乐队，1985年至1990年间活跃于加利福尼亚州莱顿维尔市郊外一个偏远的山间乡村社区——铁峰（Iron Peak）。

f89758be-c7e4-4e90-9bf5-19ca09201d84.source: Antranik Khachaturian (born May 4, 1975) also known as Andy Khachaturian or artistically as Ontronik (stylized as OnTroniK), is an American musician, producer and DJ.
f89758be-c7e4-4e90-9bf5-19ca09201d84.text: 安特拉尼克·哈恰图良（Antranik Khachaturian，1975年5月4日出生），又名安迪·哈恰图良（Andy Khachaturian），艺名Ontronik（风格化拼写为OnTroniK），是一位美国音乐人、制作人和DJ。

8df68f6c-40c0-4c9a-9343-ed949cb5ffcd.source: Spacemonkeyz are a musical group consisting of Darren Galea (DJ D-Zire), Richie Stevens and Gavin Dodds.
8df68f6c-40c0-4c9a-9343-ed949cb5ffcd.text: Spacemonkeyz 是一支由达伦·加莱亚（Darren Galea，艺名 DJ D-Zire）、里奇·史蒂文斯（Richie Stevens）和加文·多兹（Gavin Dodds）组成的乐队。

988b6d74-74a3-4476-8987-8eea6ca11117.source: Eleven was an American alternative rock supergroup from Los Angeles, California, formed in 1990 by Alain Johannes (vocals, guitar, sitar, horns), Natasha Shneider (vocals, keyboards, bass), and Jack Irons (drums).
988b6d74-74a3-4476-8987-8eea6ca11117.text: Eleven是一支来自加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的美国另类摇滚超级乐队，由阿兰·约翰内斯（主唱、吉他、西塔琴、铜管乐器）、娜塔莎·施奈德（主唱、键盘、贝斯）和杰克·艾恩斯（鼓手）于1990年组建。

75be5447-9d9b-41c7-965c-fd4a0985576f.source: The Frustrators are an American punk rock band with Jason Chandler (lead vocals), Terry Linehan (guitar, vocals), Art Tedeschi (drums), and Mike Dirnt (bass, vocals).
75be5447-9d9b-41c7-965c-fd4a0985576f.text: The Frustrators 是一支美国朋克摇滚乐队，成员包括杰森·钱德勒（主唱）、特里·莱纳汉（吉他、和声）、阿特·泰代斯基（鼓手）和迈克·迪恩特（贝斯、和声）。

a45c61bf-3728-4ca6-a142-bfe6075e1976.source: The Bicycle Thief is an American alternative rock band fronted by Bob Forrest.
a45c61bf-3728-4ca6-a142-bfe6075e1976.text: The Bicycle Thief 是一支由鲍勃·福雷斯特（Bob Forrest）担任主唱的美国另类摇滚乐队。

009a44cd-e5b7-4b0f-beee-64391f8e93fd.source: Spinnerette was an alternative rock band formed in 2007.
009a44cd-e5b7-4b0f-beee-64391f8e93fd.text: Spinnerette是一支成立于2007年的另类摇滚乐队。

416e1f41-2c04-493c-a61f-ea34d1ee8ef8.source: Achozen ([pronounced: UH-choh-zen]) (occasionally typeset as AcHoZeN) is a supergroup by System of a Down bassist Shavo Odadjian, Wu-Tang Clan member RZA, Killarmy member Kinetic 9, and Wu-Tang Clan affiliate Reverend William Burke.
416e1f41-2c04-493c-a61f-ea34d1ee8ef8.text: Achozen（[发音：UH-choh-zen]）（有时也拼写为 AcHoZeN）是由 System of a Down 贝斯手 Shavo Odadjian 组建的超级乐队， “武当帮”（Wu-Tang Clan）成员RZA、“Killarmy”成员Kinetic 9，以及“武当帮”关联艺人威廉·伯克牧师（Reverend William Burke）共同组建的超级乐队。

08f3baa2-9962-4fa7-a8c7-95d64d75d348.source: Apparatjik ( ap-ə-RAT-chik) are a multi-national band formed in 2008.
08f3baa2-9962-4fa7-a8c7-95d64d75d348.text: Apparatjik（发音：ap-ə-RAT-chik）是一支成立于2008年的跨国乐队。

09dec2be-aeff-4e26-a9d6-a934d2620223.source: Trauma is an American heavy metal band formed in 1981.
09dec2be-aeff-4e26-a9d6-a934d2620223.text: Trauma 是一支成立于 1981 年的美国重金属乐队。

a3c1211b-9422-43be-a75c-5b6778e7c0b6.source: Band Aid 30 is the 2014 incarnation of the charity supergroup Band Aid.
a3c1211b-9422-43be-a75c-5b6778e7c0b6.text: Band Aid 30 是慈善超级乐队 Band Aid 在 2014 年的重组版本。

e472c434-9eb9-41d3-b493-0d2f115faed2.source: Reverend and the Makers are an English rock band from Sheffield, South Yorkshire.
e472c434-9eb9-41d3-b493-0d2f115faed2.text: Reverend and the Makers 是一支来自南约克郡谢菲尔德的英国摇滚乐队。

dd602e6c-f4d3-4c16-8398-1b137bed8512.source: The Longshot is an American rock band formed in Oakland, California, in 2018 by Green Day frontman Billie Joe Armstrong.
dd602e6c-f4d3-4c16-8398-1b137bed8512.text: The Longshot 是一支美国摇滚乐队，由绿日乐队（Green Day）主唱比利·乔·阿姆斯特朗（Billie Joe Armstrong）于 2018 年在加利福尼亚州奥克兰市组建。

01b73d81-4390-4ebd-984d-f84b4d5ed5b0.source: The Coverups is an American cover band that serves as a side project for Green Day members Billie Joe Armstrong and Mike Dirnt.
01b73d81-4390-4ebd-984d-f84b4d5ed5b0.text: The Coverups 是一支美国翻唱乐队，由绿日乐队（Green Day）成员比利·乔·阿姆斯特朗（Billie Joe Armstrong）和迈克·迪恩特（Mike Dirnt）作为副业组建。

f3bf94d3-8cff-4d43-a5c4-e34da969148d.source: Seven Hours After Violet is an American metalcore band formed by System of a Down bassist Shavo Odadjian in 2024.
f3bf94d3-8cff-4d43-a5c4-e34da969148d.text: Seven Hours After Violet 是一支美国金属核乐队，由 System of a Down 的贝斯手 Shavo Odadjian 于 2024 年组建。

c43c7134-5d6f-4bfa-8275-b4012ae97c46.source: The Adolescents are an American punk rock band formed in Fullerton, California in 1979.
c43c7134-5d6f-4bfa-8275-b4012ae97c46.text: The Adolescents 是一支美国朋克摇滚乐队，于 1979 年在加利福尼亚州富勒顿市成立。

d3a4e499-19cf-4676-8aff-4a326b47cdb2.source: Redd Kross is an American rock band from Hawthorne, California, who had their roots in 1978 in a punk rock band called the Tourists, which was started by brothers Jeff and Steve McDonald while Steve was still in middle school.
d3a4e499-19cf-4676-8aff-4a326b47cdb2.text: Redd Kross 是一支来自加利福尼亚州霍桑的美国摇滚乐队，其前身是 1978 年由杰夫和史蒂夫·麦克唐纳兄弟创立的朋克摇滚乐队“The Tourists”，当时史蒂夫还是一名初中生。

bea10050-d80f-4280-98fe-23c9d945beb0.source: The Weirdos are an American punk rock band from Los Angeles.
bea10050-d80f-4280-98fe-23c9d945beb0.text: The Weirdos 是一支来自洛杉矶的美国朋克摇滚乐队。

cb8b0935-af9d-4d26-8ceb-dbfeeaf75aad.source: The Fire Theft was an American rock band from Seattle, Washington.
cb8b0935-af9d-4d26-8ceb-dbfeeaf75aad.text: The Fire Theft 是一支来自华盛顿州西雅图的美国摇滚乐队。

cec8cd6a-e3e6-464d-a3e1-ed4ab9953c9a.source: Fenix TX (styled as Fenix*TX) is an American pop punk band.
cec8cd6a-e3e6-464d-a3e1-ed4ab9953c9a.text: Fenix TX（标注为 Fenix*TX）是一支美国流行朋克乐队。

578fcf30-a232-4260-8f72-769daac8c908.source: Splendid was a musical duo of Angie Hart and Jesse Tobias, who at the time were also husband and wife.
578fcf30-a232-4260-8f72-769daac8c908.text: Splendid 是一支由安吉·哈特（Angie Hart）和杰西·托比亚斯（Jesse Tobias）组成的双人乐队，当时两人也是夫妻。

e423d2df-ad70-4c7a-9803-5b2843457ca6.source: Aleka's Attic was an alternative folk/rock band from Gainesville, Florida, formed by River Phoenix and Josh Greenbaum in April 1987.
e423d2df-ad70-4c7a-9803-5b2843457ca6.text: Aleka's Attic 是一支来自佛罗里达州盖恩斯维尔的另类民谣/摇滚乐队，由里弗·菲尼克斯和乔什·格林鲍姆于1987年4月组建。

0d501a8e-e923-4885-8a50-4c6cb11265d6.source: Army of Anyone was an American rock supergroup formed by Filter frontman Richard Patrick with two members of rock band Stone Temple Pilots.
0d501a8e-e923-4885-8a50-4c6cb11265d6.text: Army of Anyone 是一支由 Filter 乐队主唱理查德·帕特里克（Richard Patrick）与摇滚乐队 Stone Temple Pilots 的两名成员共同组建的美国摇滚超级乐队。

d063c9b2-155a-4545-9285-a99e4866e735.source: Taylor Hawkins & The Coattail Riders was an American rock band founded by Taylor Hawkins, drummer for Foo Fighters.
d063c9b2-155a-4545-9285-a99e4866e735.text: Taylor Hawkins & The Coattail Riders 是一支由 Foo Fighters 乐队鼓手泰勒·霍金斯（Taylor Hawkins）创立的美国摇滚乐队。

9dad4a09-50dd-43a4-b9da-c0dbcc8c8030.source: Deconstruction was an American alternative rock band formed by bassist/singer Eric Avery and guitarist Dave Navarro, both formerly of Jane's Addiction, with drummer Michael Murphy.
9dad4a09-50dd-43a4-b9da-c0dbcc8c8030.text: Deconstruction是一支美国另类摇滚乐队，由贝斯手兼主唱埃里克·艾弗里（Eric Avery）和吉他手戴夫·纳瓦罗（Dave Navarro）——两人均曾是Jane's Addiction乐队成员——与鼓手迈克尔·墨菲（Michael Murphy）共同组建。

25c7930a-499d-460f-a26b-7baaf3460d2c.source: Jackson United is an American punk rock band, formed by singer and lead guitarist Chris Shiflett in 2002.
25c7930a-499d-460f-a26b-7baaf3460d2c.text: Jackson United 是一支美国朋克摇滚乐队，由主唱兼主音吉他手克里斯·希弗莱特（Chris Shiflett）于 2002 年组建。

e3bcef9d-c2cd-44cb-a4ef-6c58914b886d.source: 12 Rounds is a British rock band formed by Atticus Ross and singer Claudia Sarne, who are married.
e3bcef9d-c2cd-44cb-a4ef-6c58914b886d.text: 12 Rounds 是一支由阿提库斯·罗斯（Atticus Ross）和歌手克劳迪娅·萨恩（Claudia Sarne）——两人是夫妻——组建的英国摇滚乐队。

496f3f84-b42f-470e-9358-9e2c047b0335.source: Mongrel were a British supergroup formed in 2008, founded by former Arctic Monkeys bassist Andy Nicholson.
496f3f84-b42f-470e-9358-9e2c047b0335.text: Mongrel是一支成立于2008年的英国超级乐队，由前Arctic Monkeys贝斯手安迪·尼科尔森（Andy Nicholson）创立。

715c3816-4ae5-46d3-8c25-62438e289d25.source: Crushed Butler were a British rock band that existed between 1969 and 1971.
715c3816-4ae5-46d3-8c25-62438e289d25.text: Crushed Butler 是一支活跃于 1969 年至 1971 年的英国摇滚乐队。

85aefc0a-a3ba-4524-8664-ec89bf42146e.source: Rock Therapy was a 1996 one-off project consisting of Queen guitarist Brian May, Rolling Stones drummer Charlie Watts, plus a number of guest vocalists including Sam Brown, Andy Fairweather Low, Paul Rodgers and Lulu.
85aefc0a-a3ba-4524-8664-ec89bf42146e.text: Rock Therapy 是 1996 年的一次性合作项目，成员包括皇后乐队（Queen）的吉他手布莱恩·梅（Brian May）、滚石乐队（Rolling Stones）的鼓手查理·瓦茨（Charlie Watts），以及萨姆·布朗（Sam Brown）、安迪·费尔韦瑟·洛（Andy Fairweather Low）、保罗·罗杰斯（Paul Rodgers）和露露（Lulu）等多位客座主唱。

bff087c0-11b4-4da3-81a0-2db10ca7cabb.source: Phantasm was an American thrash metal band from Los Angeles, active between 1986 and 1988.
bff087c0-11b4-4da3-81a0-2db10ca7cabb.text: Phantasm是一支来自洛杉矶的美国鞭击金属乐队，活跃于1986年至1988年。

f530f536-e877-49de-b0d2-baad9984df5b.source: Dot Hacker is an American experimental rock band from California, formed in 2008.
f530f536-e877-49de-b0d2-baad9984df5b.text: Dot Hacker 是一支来自加利福尼亚州的美国实验摇滚乐队，成立于 2008 年。

f28fabab-7535-417c-a89e-9df4287ffe29.source: Mass Mental (also stylized as Mass Mental?) is an American rock band.
f28fabab-7535-417c-a89e-9df4287ffe29.text: Mass Mental（也写作 Mass Mental？）是一支美国摇滚乐队。

9b52f235-714b-4b76-b85b-ebc07363db7f.source: The Bottletop Band is a supergroup consisting of leading musicians of both Brazilian and English music.
9b52f235-714b-4b76-b85b-ebc07363db7f.text: The Bottletop Band 是一支由巴西和英国乐坛顶尖音乐人组成的超级乐队。

54c982d5-f078-46f3-a7ce-f9d63433ffbe.source: WhoCares was a supergroup formed by Ian Gillan of Deep Purple and Tony Iommi of Black Sabbath in 2011 with the participation of a great number of rock artists as a charity project to raise money to rebuild a music school in Gyumri, Armenia, after the destruction of the city in the 1988 earthquake in Armenia.
54c982d5-f078-46f3-a7ce-f9d63433ffbe.text: WhoCares是由深紫乐队的伊恩·吉兰和黑色安息日乐队的托尼·艾奥米于2011年组建的一支超级乐队，众多摇滚音乐人参与其中，该项目作为一项慈善计划，旨在为重建位于久姆里的音乐学校筹集资金， 亚美尼亚1988年地震导致该市遭到破坏后，重建当地一所音乐学校。

6f29020d-49c1-4e26-869a-0603d14b7ca7.source: Stabbing Westward is an American industrial rock band.
6f29020d-49c1-4e26-869a-0603d14b7ca7.text: Stabbing Westward 是一支美国工业摇滚乐队。

2865730a-5757-4005-875e-84d6274cb1c0.source: Revolting Cocks, also known as RevCo, are an American-Belgian industrial rock band, and sometimes supergroup, that began as a musical side project for Richard 23 of Front 242, Luc van Acker, and Al Jourgensen of Ministry.
2865730a-5757-4005-875e-84d6274cb1c0.text: Revolting Cocks（又名 RevCo）是一支美比混血工业摇滚乐队，有时也被视为超级乐队，最初由 Front 242 乐队的 Richard 23、Luc van Acker 以及 Ministry 乐队的 Al Jourgensen 共同发起，作为他们的音乐副业项目。

f012c04d-96ca-47dd-9359-3bb11fed88b5.source: DYS is an American straight edge hardcore punk band from Boston, Massachusetts, who were part of the "Boston Crew" in the 1980s, along with contemporaries such as SSD and Negative FX.
f012c04d-96ca-47dd-9359-3bb11fed88b5.text: DYS是一支来自马萨诸塞州波士顿的美国直边硬核朋克乐队，上世纪80年代曾作为“波士顿军团”的一员，与SSD和Negative FX等同时代乐队并肩而立。

a5f8887e-e178-4969-ba9a-18a64156c42f.source: Methods of Mayhem is an American rap rock/metal band formed in 1999 by Tommy Lee, who had temporarily quit his position as Mötley Crüe's drummer.
a5f8887e-e178-4969-ba9a-18a64156c42f.text: Methods of Mayhem 是一支美国说唱摇滚/金属乐队，由曾暂时辞去 Mötley Crüe 鼓手职务的汤米·李（Tommy Lee）于 1999 年组建。

6c0994fb-382e-4510-8e26-56709afaf190.source: Juno was an American indie rock band formed in Seattle, Washington in 1995.
6c0994fb-382e-4510-8e26-56709afaf190.text: Juno是一支美国独立摇滚乐队，于1995年在华盛顿州西雅图成立。

117a8255-3b06-4339-b5ba-038d0fdb6a85.source: Jakalope was a Canadian Indie pop/rock group.
117a8255-3b06-4339-b5ba-038d0fdb6a85.text: Jakalope 是一支来自加拿大的独立流行/摇滚乐队。

0ba96c43-c23c-40c7-88e7-b1afe7956cc9.source: The Damage Manual were an English industrial supergroup formed in London in 2000.
0ba96c43-c23c-40c7-88e7-b1afe7956cc9.text: The Damage Manual 是一支于 2000 年在伦敦成立的英国工业音乐超级乐队。

29e7a565-5ae6-4bed-9fa5-7f9a74d5f2e3.source: Goon Moon is an American rock band composed of Jeordie White (also known as Twiggy Ramirez) and Chris Goss.
29e7a565-5ae6-4bed-9fa5-7f9a74d5f2e3.text: Goon Moon 是一支由 Jeordie White（又名 Twiggy Ramirez）和 Chris Goss 组成的美国摇滚乐队。

d41885a6-14ce-4ea4-8ce7-d0b222af897e.source: Skrew is an American industrial metal band.
d41885a6-14ce-4ea4-8ce7-d0b222af897e.text: Skrew 是一支美国工业金属乐队。

ada7ccb0-8dd8-467c-9859-abb0683884bb.source: Wool was an American rock band from Washington, D.C., and based in Los Angeles.
ada7ccb0-8dd8-467c-9859-abb0683884bb.text: Wool是一支来自华盛顿特区的美国摇滚乐队，常驻洛杉矶。

10c058a2-41e6-4f64-8cdd-fa3c7f2be9c0.source: The Honeydrippers were an English rock and roll band of the 1980s.
10c058a2-41e6-4f64-8cdd-fa3c7f2be9c0.text: The Honeydrippers 是 1980 年代的一支英国摇滚乐队。

54fc7b6c-6cfb-4ce3-bc9b-60dfc6e90764.source: ℞ or Rx was a one-off side project by Skinny Puppy band member Nivek Ogre, in collaboration with Invisible Records founder Martin Atkins.
54fc7b6c-6cfb-4ce3-bc9b-60dfc6e90764.text: ℞ 或 Rx 是 Skinny Puppy 乐队成员 Nivek Ogre 与 Invisible Records 创始人 Martin Atkins 合作推出的一次性副项目。

9e8cc0e8-8d46-4a21-8a9d-904872699e60.source: Alexis Korner's Blues Incorporated, or simply Blues Incorporated, were an English blues band formed in London in 1961, led by Alexis Korner and including at various times Jack Bruce, Charlie Watts, Terry Cox, Ginger Baker, Art Wood, Long John Baldry, Ronnie Jones, Danny Thompson, Graham Bond, Cyril Davies, and Dick Heckstall-Smith.
9e8cc0e8-8d46-4a21-8a9d-904872699e60.text: 亚历克西斯·科纳的“蓝调公司”（Alexis Korner's Blues Incorporated，或简称“蓝调公司”）是一支于1961年在伦敦成立的英国蓝调乐队，由亚历克西斯·科纳领军，成员包括（不同时期）：杰克·布鲁斯、查理·瓦茨、特里·考克斯、金杰·贝克、阿特·伍德、长约翰·博尔德里、罗尼·琼斯、 丹尼·汤普森、格雷厄姆·邦德、西里尔·戴维斯和迪克·赫克斯托尔-史密斯。

5dd561f7-7264-42cb-a3b2-bddeb750eb39.source: Modwheelmood (also typeset as ModWheelMood or modwheelmood and abbreviated as MWM) is an American electronic/alternative pop band from Los Angeles, California, formed in 1998 by Alessandro Cortini (who is also part of the Nine Inch Nails concert lineup and former Abandoned Pools guitarist Pelle Hillström.
5dd561f7-7264-42cb-a3b2-bddeb750eb39.text: Modwheelmood（也写作 ModWheelMood 或 modwheelmood，简称 MWM）是一支来自加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的美国电子/另类流行乐队，由亚历山德罗·科尔蒂尼（Alessandro Cortini） （他同时也是“九寸钉”巡演阵容成员）与前“Abandoned Pools”乐队吉他手佩勒·希尔斯特伦于1998年共同组建。

0bb07307-3785-4668-9e9e-1a36f9f36937.source: Monsula was an American punk rock band from the San Francisco Bay Area, California, United States.
0bb07307-3785-4668-9e9e-1a36f9f36937.text: Monsula 是一支来自美国加利福尼亚州旧金山湾区的美国朋克摇滚乐队。

7e870dd5-2667-454b-9fcf-a132dd8071f1.source: Jack Off Jill was an American alternative rock band from Fort Lauderdale, Florida, formed in 1992 by vocalist Jessicka, drummer Tenni Ah-Cha-Cha, bassist/keyboardist Agent Moulder, and guitarist Michelle Inhell.
7e870dd5-2667-454b-9fcf-a132dd8071f1.text: Jack Off Jill是一支来自佛罗里达州劳德代尔堡的美国另类摇滚乐队，由主唱杰西卡（Jessicka）、鼓手特尼·阿-查-查（Tenni Ah-Cha-Cha）、贝斯手兼键盘手阿杰特·莫尔德（Agent Moulder）以及吉他手米歇尔·因赫尔（Michelle Inhell）于1992年组建。

d4bca920-3e2a-4990-9953-5032a1be78c0.source: Primitive Race is an international industrial rock supergroup created by Chris Kniker and featuring Raymond Watts (PIG, KMFDM), Dave Ogilvie (SLogan J), Mark Gimli Rasit (Peter Murphy, Spear of Destiny, Tricky, Mob Research, The Mission, Gary Numan), Erie Loch (LUXT, Blownload, Exageist), Chuck Mosley (ex-Faith No More), Graham Crabb (Pop Will Eat Itself) and Kourtney Klein (Combichrist, Nitzer Ebb).
d4bca920-3e2a-4990-9953-5032a1be78c0.text: Primitive Race 是一支由克里斯·尼克尔（Chris Kniker）组建的国际工业摇滚超级乐队，成员包括雷蒙德·瓦茨（Raymond Watts，曾效力于 PIG、KMFDM）、戴夫·奥吉尔维（Dave Ogilvie，曾效力于 SLogan J）， 马克·吉米·拉西特（Mark Gimli Rasit，曾与彼得·墨菲、Spear of Destiny、Tricky、Mob Research、The Mission、加里·纽曼合作）、伊里·洛克（Erie Loch，曾效力于LUXT、Blownload、Exageist）、 查克·莫斯利（Chuck Mosley，前Faith No More成员）、格雷厄姆·克拉布（Graham Crabb，Pop Will Eat Itself成员）以及科特妮·克莱因（Kourtney Klein，Combichrist、Nitzer Ebb成员）。

93557aa9-1ced-421a-b026-5a0aee62fa75.source: The Birds of Satan were an American progressive hard rock supergroup, assembled in 2014 as a side-project led by Taylor Hawkins of the Foo Fighters.
93557aa9-1ced-421a-b026-5a0aee62fa75.text: The Birds of Satan 是一支美国前卫硬摇滚超级乐队，由 Foo Fighters 乐队的泰勒·霍金斯（Taylor Hawkins）于 2014 年组建，作为其个人副业项目。

661c8840-8a2f-4626-9edf-68be40656c4a.source: The Big Cats are an American rock band from Little Rock, Arkansas.
661c8840-8a2f-4626-9edf-68be40656c4a.text: The Big Cats 是一支来自阿肯色州小石城的美国摇滚乐队。

3a8ee67d-c722-423e-8c85-4e54dd1ad0f1.source: Vimic is an American heavy metal band consisting of Jed Simon, Kyle Konkiel, Matthew Tarach, Kalen Chase, and Steve Marshall.
3a8ee67d-c722-423e-8c85-4e54dd1ad0f1.text: Vimic 是一支美国重金属乐队，成员包括杰德·西蒙（Jed Simon）、凯尔·康基尔（Kyle Konkiel）、马修·塔拉赫（Matthew Tarach）、卡伦·蔡斯（Kalen Chase）和史蒂夫·马歇尔（Steve Marshall）。

42c4b58d-2e28-41d4-bfe5-4edee68386cf.source: The Germs were an American punk rock band from Los Angeles, California, originally active from 1976 to 1980.
42c4b58d-2e28-41d4-bfe5-4edee68386cf.text: The Germs 是一支来自加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的美国朋克摇滚乐队，最初活跃于 1976 年至 1980 年间。

30fda151-9520-44b5-82ba-a9ed7bce85c4.source: Robert Steven "Adrian" Belew (born December 23, 1949) is an American musician, singer, songwriter, and record producer.
30fda151-9520-44b5-82ba-a9ed7bce85c4.text: 罗伯特·史蒂文·“阿德里安”·贝勒（Robert Steven "Adrian" Belew，1949年12月23日出生）是一位美国音乐家、歌手、词曲作者和唱片制作人。

337027f4-4f29-42f4-bc4d-63e7d4e74e1a.source: 45 Grave is an American rock band from Los Angeles formed in 1979.
337027f4-4f29-42f4-bc4d-63e7d4e74e1a.text: 45 Grave 是一支来自洛杉矶的美国摇滚乐队，成立于 1979 年。

23df4094-9d65-4173-8235-f7bf1c723bd2.source: Redd Kross is an American rock band from Hawthorne, California, who had their roots in 1978 in a punk rock band called the Tourists, which was started by brothers Jeff and Steve McDonald while Steve was still in middle school.
23df4094-9d65-4173-8235-f7bf1c723bd2.text: Redd Kross 是一支来自加利福尼亚州霍桑的美国摇滚乐队，其前身是 1978 年由杰夫和史蒂夫·麦克唐纳兄弟创立的朋克摇滚乐队“The Tourists”，当时史蒂夫还是一名初中生。

57928ae9-5742-408f-b953-9e1c8110b405.source: The Tear Garden is a psychedelic/experimental/electronic band formed by Edward Ka-Spel of the Legendary Pink Dots and cEvin Key of Skinny Puppy in 1985 after Key served as a sound engineer on tour in Canada for Ka-Spel.
57928ae9-5742-408f-b953-9e1c8110b405.text: The Tear Garden 是一支迷幻/实验/电子乐队，由“传奇粉红点”（Legendary Pink Dots）的爱德华·卡-斯佩尔（Edward Ka-Spel）和“瘦小幼崽”（Skinny Puppy）的塞文·基（cEvin Key）于1985年共同组建。此前，基曾作为卡-斯佩尔在加拿大巡演时的音响工程师。

4c44479c-8fde-4754-b9e2-5129eb6fb28d.source: 1000 Homo DJs was a side project of American industrial rock band Ministry.
4c44479c-8fde-4754-b9e2-5129eb6fb28d.text: 1000 Homo DJs 是美国工业摇滚乐队 Ministry 的副项目。

787aa69f-f419-4e24-8c13-33511a20428d.source: Samiam (pronounced "sam-I-am") is an American punk rock band from Berkeley, California, active since 1988.
787aa69f-f419-4e24-8c13-33511a20428d.text: Samiam（发音为“sam-I-am”）是一支来自加利福尼亚州伯克利的美国朋克摇滚乐队，自1988年起活跃至今。

bdd9619a-f369-4401-a181-7b50cf8f407f.source: Error was an American digital hardcore band founded in 2003 by 12 Rounds member and Nine Inch Nails collaborator Atticus Ross, and Bad Religion guitarist Brett Gurewitz.
bdd9619a-f369-4401-a181-7b50cf8f407f.text: Error是一支美国数字硬核乐队，由12 Rounds乐队成员、九寸钉乐队（Nine Inch Nails）的合作者阿提库斯·罗斯（Atticus Ross）与Bad Religion乐队吉他手布雷特·古雷维茨（Brett Gurewitz）于2003年共同创立。

a8588753-5e1b-4ac0-8030-896b70c78cf4.source: Band of Joy (sometimes known as Robert Plant and the Band of Joy) were an English rock band formed in 1966.
a8588753-5e1b-4ac0-8030-896b70c78cf4.text: Band of Joy（有时也被称为 Robert Plant and the Band of Joy）是一支成立于1966年的英国摇滚乐队。

bbcf65ec-b49a-4612-a767-c1062fba84f8.source: Tweaker is an American band founded by Chris Vrenna in the late 1990s.
bbcf65ec-b49a-4612-a767-c1062fba84f8.text: Tweaker 是一支由克里斯·弗雷纳（Chris Vrenna）于 20 世纪 90 年代末创立的美国乐队。

447411ac-af07-423a-9be1-12ae0cafc640.source: Lucky Pierre is a new wave band, founded in Cleveland in 1974 by singer-songwriter, guitarist and the only constant member, Kevin McMahon.
447411ac-af07-423a-9be1-12ae0cafc640.text: Lucky Pierre 是一支新浪潮乐队，由唱作人、吉他手兼乐队唯一元老成员凯文·麦克马洪（Kevin McMahon）于 1974 年在克利夫兰创立。

1268cf43-fa5d-48fd-a0b7-2fb5bcb8ee72.source: Prick was an American industrial rock band, founded in 1992 in Los Angeles by guitarist and songwriter Kevin McMahon, after his first project Lucky Pierre disbanded.
1268cf43-fa5d-48fd-a0b7-2fb5bcb8ee72.text: Prick是一支美国工业摇滚乐队，由吉他手兼词曲作者凯文·麦克马洪（Kevin McMahon）于1992年在洛杉矶创立，此前他的首个乐队Lucky Pierre已解散。

43da6916-ba67-48cb-b875-4936adde20dd.source: The ProjeKcts are a succession of experimental spin-off groups associated with the English progressive rock band King Crimson.
43da6916-ba67-48cb-b875-4936adde20dd.text: The ProjeKcts 是一系列与英国前卫摇滚乐队 King Crimson 相关的实验性衍生乐队。

42509bd3-6fa1-459a-8e40-127a3ef8663b.source: Hilt was a collective group of Vancouver musicians, usually referred to as a side project of the group Skinny Puppy.
42509bd3-6fa1-459a-8e40-127a3ef8663b.text: Hilt 是由温哥华音乐人组成的团体，通常被视为乐队 Skinny Puppy 的副项目。

564ce54b-bed1-4e75-aa2b-803934b43c85.source: The Soultronics was an R&B and neo soul supergroup formed in 2000, which served as the backing band for musician D'Angelo in 2000 during The Voodoo Tour, the supporting tour for his second studio album Voodoo.
564ce54b-bed1-4e75-aa2b-803934b43c85.text: The Soultronics 是一支成立于 2000 年的 R&B 和新灵魂乐超级乐队，曾在 2000 年担任音乐人 D'Angelo 的伴奏乐队，参与了其第二张录音室专辑《Voodoo》的宣传巡演“The Voodoo Tour”。

c97a50b1-e2c7-4810-99b9-061e6da522b2.source: The Influents were an American punk rock band formed in 1999 by Jason White and Bill Schneider.
c97a50b1-e2c7-4810-99b9-061e6da522b2.text: The Influents 是一支美国朋克摇滚乐队，由杰森·怀特（Jason White）和比尔·施耐德（Bill Schneider）于1999年组建。

6a93cb2b-d33a-42fc-a41a-542e3a887ba6.source: The Voidz (formerly Julian Casablancas + The Voidz) are an experimental rock band.
6a93cb2b-d33a-42fc-a41a-542e3a887ba6.text: The Voidz（前身为 Julian Casablancas + The Voidz）是一支实验摇滚乐队。

e89e325e-ae11-4c2a-86a8-3e9a967ffda3.source: The Black Queen is an American electronic supergroup formed in Los Angeles in 2015.
e89e325e-ae11-4c2a-86a8-3e9a967ffda3.text: The Black Queen 是一支于 2015 年在洛杉矶成立的美国电子音乐超级乐队。

2ab80f85-4b7f-4be8-a74f-a954c8f53cbb.source: Gizmodrome (sometimes known as Copeland, King, Cosma & Belew) is a British-Italian-American rock supergroup formed in Milan, Italy in 2017.
2ab80f85-4b7f-4be8-a74f-a954c8f53cbb.text: Gizmodrome（有时也被称为Copeland, King, Cosma & Belew）是一支由英国、意大利和美国音乐人组成的摇滚超级乐队，于2017年在意大利米兰成立。

82d6c629-d9cf-46c7-aa1e-a511eb344ab1.source: Boogie Box High was an English pop musical project headed by Andros Georgiou in the late 1980s that featured a range of collaborators, including George Michael, guitarist Nick Heyward (of Haircut One Hundred), keyboardist Mick Talbot (of the Style Council), guitarist–songwriter David Austin, bassist Deon Estus, and others.
82d6c629-d9cf-46c7-aa1e-a511eb344ab1.text: Boogie Box High 是 1980 年代末由安德罗斯·乔治欧（Andros Georgiou）领衔的英国流行音乐项目，参与合作的音乐人包括乔治·迈克尔（George Michael）、吉他手尼克·海沃德（Nick Heyward，来自 Haircut One Hundred 乐队）、键盘手米克·塔尔博特（Mick Talbot，来自 The Style Council 乐队）， 吉他手兼词曲作者大卫·奥斯汀、贝斯手迪昂·埃斯图斯等人。

057aa66c-cf6e-499d-bda8-5adc47ad4197.source: Fantômas is an American experimental metal supergroup formed in 1998 in California.
057aa66c-cf6e-499d-bda8-5adc47ad4197.text: Fantômas 是一支美国实验金属超级乐队，于 1998 年在加利福尼亚州成立。

0b08dcc7-9f5c-4a25-a182-f8ceb13f1972.source: The Horny Horns were a horn section associated with Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy's Rubber Band led by trombonist Fred Wesley.
0b08dcc7-9f5c-4a25-a182-f8ceb13f1972.text: The Horny Horns 是一支与 Parliament-Funkadelic 和 Bootsy's Rubber Band 相关的铜管乐队，由长号手弗雷德·韦斯利（Fred Wesley）领衔。

c1fb4936-e47a-4a52-b1eb-f3f1606a1d4b.source: In 2000, while the band King Crimson were recording the album The ConstruKction of Light, the four members simultaneously recorded improvised material as ProjeKct X.
c1fb4936-e47a-4a52-b1eb-f3f1606a1d4b.text: 2000年，当King Crimson乐队正在录制专辑《The ConstruKction of Light》时，四位成员同时以ProjeKct X的名义录制了即兴创作的素材。

f82ac8f9-5390-4123-87f8-7c8fb10649b2.source: The Exotic Birds was an American Synthpop music group formed in Cleveland, Ohio, United States, in 1982 by three Cleveland Institute of Music percussion students (Andy Kubiszewski, Tom Freer and Timothy Adams Jr.
f82ac8f9-5390-4123-87f8-7c8fb10649b2.text: The Exotic Birds 是一支美国合成器流行乐队，于 1982 年由三位克利夫兰音乐学院的打击乐专业学生（安迪·库比泽夫斯基、汤姆·弗里尔和小蒂莫西·亚当斯）在美国俄亥俄州克利夫兰市组建。

45dc44ab-ebd5-48ed-9fc9-6f8de561656d.source: Die Warzau (originally Die Warsaw Synfony) was an American industrial music band formed in 1987 by Jim Marcus and Van Christie.
45dc44ab-ebd5-48ed-9fc9-6f8de561656d.text: Die Warzau（原名 Die Warsaw Synfony）是一支美国工业音乐乐队，由吉姆·马库斯（Jim Marcus）和范·克里斯蒂（Van Christie）于1987年组建。

9e47e029-e63d-48d8-a8b8-fd46cc9db1ce.source: Denver Harbor was an American alternative rock band, based in San Diego, California.
9e47e029-e63d-48d8-a8b8-fd46cc9db1ce.text: Denver Harbor 是一支来自美国加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥的另类摇滚乐队。

ecb6b31e-b37d-4d4e-92c5-535650bfac1e.source: Low Pop Suicide was an alternative rock band, formed in 1991 by Rick Boston (lead vocals/guitars), Dave Allen (bass), and Jeff Ward (drums/backing vocals).
ecb6b31e-b37d-4d4e-92c5-535650bfac1e.text: Low Pop Suicide 是一支另类摇滚乐队，由里克·波士顿（主唱/吉他）、戴夫·艾伦（贝斯）和杰夫·沃德（鼓手/和声）于1991年组建。

85c98899-dd47-435d-9977-8ff45910f111.source: Howlin' Maggie was a four-piece band founded by (and fronted by) Harold "Happy" Chichester in Columbus, Ohio, in 1994.
85c98899-dd47-435d-9977-8ff45910f111.text: Howlin' Maggie 是一支四人乐队，由哈罗德·“快乐”·奇切斯特于1994年在俄亥俄州哥伦布市创立并担任主唱。

6b4fbe0d-c8ea-451c-9fe1-afcb90f5e605.source: FFS (an abbreviation of Franz Ferdinand and Sparks) was a supergroup formed by Scottish indie rock band Franz Ferdinand and American art rock band Sparks.
6b4fbe0d-c8ea-451c-9fe1-afcb90f5e605.text: FFS（Franz Ferdinand 和 Sparks 的缩写）是由苏格兰独立摇滚乐队 Franz Ferdinand 和美国艺术摇滚乐队 Sparks 共同组建的一支超级乐队。
